source: 249-case E2E suite (v1 60 + v2 40 + v3 149) against a local gateway running HEAD 2a4cd7a4a, 2026-09-28 live rerun
notes: collapse_rate = decided cases whose candidate pool fell back (fallback_used). RATCHET, not aspiration: 0.08 sits above the known-open composition measured 2026-09-28 — 13/249 collapse, ALL 13 of them task_type=code_audit, whose candidate pool is structurally size 1 (only minimax-m3/cred 21 carries it; quality=0, reliability=0, tier empty). Every other one of the 11 task types held 3 candidates on all 249 cases. That code_audit gap is PRE-EXISTING and still unfixed: A/B on 3 prompts against the pre-existing deployed build 2296 (SHA 0ae9b5e2) returns an identical cand=1/fallback=True/score=50 decision, so it is neither introduced nor repaired by the L-4 / planning-artifact / M-7 commits. Root cause is capability-annotation coverage (models_canonical.tags publishes cap:long-context/tool-use/function-call/reasoning/vision but no code/review/security tag, so code_audit has no represented vocabulary), the same ~870-model annotation gap already registered in docs/audit/2026-09-28-auto-routing-selection-layer-audit.md §6.2 — fixing it needs operator annotation, not a code change. Do NOT read a PASS here as code_audit being fixed: this threshold fires only on collapse BEYOND the registered code_audit floor. The archived 0.0/240 that this file previously encoded is contradicted by the live rerun and should not be cited as current. Only evaluated when -e2e-report is supplied — the offline classification gate cannot compute it.
